note: Unmodified original RGB in an opaque WebGL2 wrapper, same defaults at 1440x900/source time2. TSL preserves signed steps, transform ordering, camera basis, four folds and source grading; it guards degenerate normal length and saturated reciprocal stripe limits, displays original RGB opaquely and adds five teaching controls. Floating-point and threshold/iteration differences remain; no pixel identity claim.

visualReview.scope: Default1440x900 only. Main foreground beams, blue grading and light-band idea agree; some distant structures visibly differ in WebGPU. Cross-backend meanRGB byte difference2.9312572016 and fraction over10=0.0471761831 are retained, not described as pixel identity. No single numerical root cause has been proved and no hash/geometry replacement was made.
